title: 「核も戦争もない世界を」胎内被爆者、廃絶訴え　NPT再検討会議で非人道性強調
extracted_text: 日本原水爆被害者団体協議会（被団協）の被爆者が1日、米ニューヨークの国連本部で開催中の核拡散防止条約（NPT）再検討会議で、核兵器の非人道性を断罪し、廃絶を訴えた。胎内被爆者で事務局長の浜住治郎さん（80）＝東京都稲城市＝は演説で「原爆は人間と共存できない、悪魔の兵器だ」と強調。「核兵器も戦争もない世界の人間社会に向け、共に力を尽くそう」と呼びかけた。 被爆者による再検討会議での演説は、2024年の被団協のノーベル平和賞受賞後初めて。1982年の国連軍縮特別総会で長崎の被爆者の故山口仙二さんが叫んだ「ノーモア・ウォー、ノーモア・ヒバクシャ！」も引用した。 浜住さんの演説は非政府組織（NGO）セッションで約4分間行われた。広島原爆で父を奪われ、自身は母のおなかの中で被爆し「父のことを思わない日はない。戦争は終わっていない」と述べた。「被爆者は人間として死ぬことも生きることもできなかった」と指摘した。
translated_text: A survivor from the Japan Confederation of A-bomb and H-bomb Sufferers Organizations (Hidankyo) spoke on the 1st at the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) Review Conference being held at the United Nations Headquarters in New York, condemning the inhumanity of nuclear weapons and calling for their abolition. Hamazumi Jiro (80), the secretary-general who was exposed to the atomic bomb while still in his mother's womb, from Inagi City, Tokyo, emphasized in his speech, "The atomic bomb is a demonic weapon that cannot coexist with humankind." He called on others to "work together toward a human society where there are no nuclear weapons or war." This was the first speech by a survivor at a Review Conference since Hidankyo received the Nobel Peace Prize in 2024. It also quoted the words "No More War, No More Hibakusha!" shouted by Nagasaki survivor Yamaguchi Senji at the 1982 UN Special Session on Disarmament. Hamazumi's speech lasted about four minutes at the non-governmental organization (NGO) session. Having lost his father in the Hiroshima bombing and having been exposed in his mother's womb, he said, "There is not a day when I don't think about my father. The war has not ended." He pointed out that "hibakusha could not even die or live as human beings."
title_en: "A World Without Nuclear Weapons or War" In-Utero Atomic Bomb Survivor Calls for Abolition at NPT Review Conference, Emphasizing Inhumanity
